_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in real values. config.json is gitignored. Keep every platform's block; leave a key blank to skip that platform. Set live to true ONLY when you are ready to actually post.
_gcal: Google Calendar two-way sync. Share ONE calendar with the service account, paste the whole key JSON on one line, set gcal_live true to read/write for real. Days: [] = every day, [5] = Saturdays only (Mon=0..Sun=6).
